description: Linchpin hybrid maintenance window: routing only. Non-majors and lock-file maintenance stack on the current maintenance/YYYY-MM window, which merges with one review; majors are raised against the default branch as their own PRs. Add it AFTER github>linchpin/renovatebot-config or github>linchpin/renovatebot-config:automerge; it does not extend either, so it cannot re-apply the default preset's rules over the automerge ones. Consume as github>linchpin/renovatebot-config:maintenance-window.

packageRules.description: Majors never ride in the window. Each is its own reviewed PR against the default branch, so one breaking major cannot strand the batch - maintenance/2026-07 on linchpin.com carried three majors and a Babel 8 regression, and its safe bumps had to be salvaged by hand.

Non-majors and lock-file maintenance stack on the window, where one review merges the month, and never on the default branch. Negated rather than naming main, because some repositories default to master.
